description: This file is a shell script that contains tests verifying the behavior of 'git update-index' and 'git add' commands when dealing with symbolic links and files beyond symlinks. It sets up test environment, runs commands, and checks for expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a given command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.
